### Audit Findings: Why Orca Lite Appears Generic/Nonfunctional

Orca Lite's generic and unpolished state is caused by three distinct structural gaps:

---

#### 1. CSS and Design Token Breakdown (Styling Gap)
Across `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/components/`, components rely on extensive custom Tailwind class names and CSS tokens that do not exist in the build configuration:
- In `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/tailwind.config.js`, `theme.extend` only configures `background: "#09090b"` and `foreground: "#fafafa"`.
- Components use undeclared color classes:
  - `bg-worktree-sidebar`, `text-worktree-sidebar-foreground`, `bg-worktree-sidebar-accent`, `border-worktree-sidebar-border`, `ring-worktree-sidebar-ring` in `Sidebar.tsx` and `WorktreeList.tsx`.
  - `bg-card`, `border-border`, `bg-sidebar`, `bg-accent`, `bg-muted`, `text-muted-foreground`, `bg-primary`, `text-primary-foreground`, `bg-status-success`, `bg-status-working`, `bg-status-warning`, `bg-status-idle`, `bg-terminal`, `text-destructive` in `App.tsx`, `WorkspaceHeader.tsx`, `TabBar.tsx`, `TerminalSplitView.tsx`, and `StatusDot.tsx`.
- Components use undeclared dimensional and animation classes:
  - `w-sidebar`, `h-titlebar`, `h-tabbar`, `min-w-tab`, `max-w-tab`, `max-w-agent`, `max-w-error`, `animate-enter`, `scrollbar-sleek`, `scrollbar-none`, `drag-region`, `no-drag`.
- **Result**: The build generates unstyled fallback elements, missing borders/backgrounds, broken layout dimensions, and unaligned titlebars.

---

#### 2. Surface Model Gap: Generic Mock vs. True Orca Surface
- `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/` is a lightweight custom shell rather than the full Orca IDE surface (which exists as a bundled artifact in `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/original-dist/`).
- In `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui/src/state/workspaceStore.ts` (`selectAgents`), "Agents" are not real background agents or autonomous processes; they are 1:1 synthetic mappings of active terminal tabs (`state.layout.tabs.flatMap(...)`).
- Crucial workspace capabilities present in the backend are completely omitted in the UI:
  - No worktree deletion dialog or preview (`cmd_worktree_delete_preview`, `cmd_worktree_delete`, `cmd_worktree_delete_destructive`).
  - No worktree dirty state check (`cmd_worktree_status`).
  - No terminal signal handling or process killing (`cmd_terminal_signal`).
  - No session recovery or list reconciliation (`cmd_terminal_list`).
  - No file tree, source control diff view, or task kanban interface.

---
